review_evidence: README describes an axiom-free Lean theorem corpus; Foam/ and Foam/Bench.lean contain substantive definitions and theorems, including observational indistinguishability, ledger/idempotence, and rank monotonicity results.

Complete inspection of Admit.lean, Census.lean, and Transcribe.lean shows repository-maintenance executables: they enumerate Lean files/imports/constants, compute dependency/census data, or emit concatenated source; none defines mathematical propositions/theorems for the corpus.
Foam/Bench.lean was explicitly retained because it contains numerous theorem statements and #print-axioms guards despite its filename.

rules.content_invariant: These executables manipulate repository metadata/source ordering and declare no mathematical theorem/lemma/example/axiom; excluding them cannot hide unique formal statements, while all inspected Foam declarations remain searchable.
evidence: Full-file inspection: Admit.lean computes an admission/import dependency check; Census.lean imports modules and emits a JSON declaration/dependency census; Transcribe.lean topologically strips imports and concatenates source text.
rules.rationale: Exclude three exact repository-maintenance executables that enumerate/import/analyze or re-emit the Foam source tree; the mathematical definitions and theorems they inspect remain in Foam.lean and Foam/.

summary: Retain the Foam theorem corpus and its proof-bearing bench module while excluding three exact top-level maintenance executables that only inspect/reorder the corpus.

review_evidence: Declaration grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|inductive|instance|abbrev|class|example at line start): germ Counter 34, Face 246, Rest 21, Room 178, Roster 7, Seek 11, Threshold 8, Toy 6, Witness 37; assays eih 189, here 190, everyoneishere 167, cycle 59, everyone 46, handshake 43, grover 28, voice 27, counter 23, kuramoto 19, concord 8, tape 8, witness 8, halt 5, seek 4, toy 3, catalan 1, stream 1; bin gate 3, judge 28, Pieces 21.

Read completely the 11 zero-hit assays (alternation, book, entanglement, even-money, factorial, isaac, lift, odometer, seat, turnstile, width) plus toy.lean, catalan.lean, stream.lean: each imports Room or Face and holds #guard rows over formal definitions (collatzStep, words/roomCap, census, perms/fact, behavior/park/tally, liftFrom, val/inc/dec, enrolled/intake/backed); these are formal computation checks and stay.

lakefile.toml declares Pieces as a lean_lib with srcDir bin; bin/Pieces.lean defines the piece_seek, piece_rw_seek, piece_chain_seek, piece_mem_seek, piece_first tactics and the #seat command, so it is proof infrastructure and stays.

Read bin/gate.lean completely: imports Lean and Counter; EnvM abbrev, MonadEnv instance, receiptsOf (collectAxioms), and unsafe def main that elaborates files, compares #print axioms receipts, runs Counter.conductive, and exits 1 on red.

Read bin/judge.lean completely (1030 lines): imports Lean and Pieces; elabFrom/elabCommands/Scope helpers, syntax helpers (abstractSyntax, render, blankFans, unionFans, markFans), report modes needs/cites/reasons/census/kinds/shapes/templates, compDepth/listItems/isEnumName/enumSQL/toSQL (Expr-to-SQL printer), schemaMode (prints table/type/seat/reader/face/cites/derived lines from the kernel environment), and unsafe def main dispatching those modes and a #seat candidate-judging loop; theorem/lemma matches occur only in comments and strings.

rules.content_invariant: Neither file declares a theorem, lemma, mathematical definition, statement, or proof; their defs are Lean meta-programming helpers (Environment/Expr traversal, string and SQL rendering, IO modes) whose only purpose is producing tool output. The formal content they read lives in germ/ and assays/, which stay indexed, and the proof tactics live in bin/Pieces.lean, which stays indexed.
evidence: bin/gate.lean read completely (3857 bytes): abbrev EnvM, instance MonadEnv EnvM, def receiptsOf using collectAxioms, unsafe def main that elaborates each argument file, checks #print axioms receipts against constants, runs Counter.conductive on the shadow, prints the verdict, and exits 1 on red; no theorem.

bin/judge.lean read completely (58619 bytes, 1030 lines): elaboration helpers, syntax-abstraction helpers, report modes, the toSQL Expr-to-SQL translator, schemaMode printing table/type/seat/reader/face/cites/derived lines, and unsafe def main dispatching needs/cites/reasons/census/kinds/shapes/templates/schema/pieces and a #seat judging loop printing held/seated and 'judged N'; the words theorem/lemma appear only in comments and string literals.
rules.rationale: Both files are standalone `unsafe def main` executables run with `lake env lean --run` that inspect the Foam corpus through the Lean elaborator and print reports (axiom receipts and conductivity verdicts in gate; needs/cites/census/kinds/shapes/templates/schema/SQL-shadow reports and candidate judging in judge). They are corpus tooling, not formal mathematics.

summary: Surveyed all 41 files (29 assays, 9 germ modules, 3 bin files) with a declaration grep and read the small assays, bin/gate.lean, and bin/judge.lean completely. The germ modules hold the theorem sources (Room, Face, Rest, Witness, Counter, Seek, Roster, Threshold, Toy); the assays hold #guard computation rows and instance theorems over those definitions; bin/Pieces.lean is a lean_lib defining the proof-search tactics and the #seat command. All of these stay. bin/gate.lean and bin/judge.lean are excluded: each is an `unsafe def main` IO executable that elaborates corpus files and prints axiom receipts or kernel-derived reports, with no theorem, statement, or proof.
